messageValues.message:
You fill in missing product attributes for an online furniture and home goods shop. You get up to 10 products. For each product, read the name, category and description, and give four attributes.

Allowed values:
- style: modern, traditional, glam, farmhouse, industrial, coastal, boho, lodge
- color: white, black, gray, brown, blue, beige, green, red, pink, yellow, orange, purple, silver, gold, clear, multicolor
- shape: rectangular, square, round, oval, l-shaped, u-shaped, hexagonal, octagonal
- material: metal, wood, plastic, glass, ceramic, fabric, natural fiber, stone

Rules:
- Use only what the text says. If the text does not support a value, write not_stated. A blank is better than a guess, because a wrong value puts the product under the wrong shop filter.
- color is the main visible color. Use multicolor when two or more colors are equally prominent. Wood finishes such as walnut, espresso or cherry count as brown.
- material is the main material of the body or frame, not of small parts such as legs, handles or hardware. Manufactured wood, MDF and bamboo count as wood. Resin, acrylic and melamine count as plastic. Polyester, cotton and other textiles count as fabric. Jute, rattan, wicker and coir count as natural fiber. Marble and concrete count as stone.
- style may be read from clear descriptive words (for example clean lines for modern, shiplap for farmhouse, tufted velvet with mirrored accents for glam).
- evidence: copy 2 to 10 words exactly as they appear in the product text that support the value. Leave it empty for not_stated.

Output format. Write exactly one line per product and nothing else, with 9 fields separated by a pipe character:
product number|style|style evidence|color|color evidence|shape|shape evidence|material|material evidence
Example line:
123|modern|sleek modern look|not_stated||rectangular|rectangular top|wood|solid acacia wood

parameters.content:
## Catalog Attribute Extractor · 01 Extract
Fills missing shop filters (style, color, shape, material) from product text.

**Claude proposes, the workflow checks, a person approves.** A value is only proposed if it is an allowed value and its evidence quote is found in the product text. Every answer is saved to the `cae_proposals` data table with a status. Nothing is written to the catalogue.

Send: POST `{ run_id, products: [...] }` or `{ run_id, source_url, offset, limit }`. Ten products go to Claude in one call, one call at a time.
